SRC-390:R001.text: Establish current CLI/protocol state and direct evidence; use SAIPEN's canonical workflow; never alter BZDECOMP's .saipen state from the SAIPEN side. BZDECOMP reference is read-only and its T-651 owns suite speed.

SRC-390:R002.text: VERIFY owns SUITE-PREFLIGHT-01 with conformance tests: last declared-command duration over 5 min requires changed-path/untracked, basename, added/removed qualified-symbol and grown-table count-fixture checks, and a green affected subset before the full suite.

SRC-390:R003.text: After a red suite run rerun only the failing script until green; inspect sibling fixtures that stub/cut the same production file, then one full run; never restart a full suite blind.

SRC-390:R004.text: saipen test suite run [T-###] --fail-fast stops at the first matching FAIL verdict (or first failing sub-test), records partial FAIL and preserves evidence semantics. Replay the BZDECOMP stub-mismatch case in a fixture repository, never BZDECOMP itself, and stop in under 2 min.

SRC-390:R005.text: Record per-sub-script durations when the runner prints them and separate SAIPEN pre/post hashing/parsing overhead; status or response digest exposes last suite duration and first failure line.

SRC-390:R006.text: saipen test suite affected [T-###] prints candidate scripts/fixtures referencing the changed paths for the agent to run before the gate; documented alternatives remain admissible under the handoff acceptance.
